nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint256) holding token balances; written by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) holding spender allowances; written by _approve.
Private uint256 total token supply; increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Private string token name, set once in the ERC20 constructor.
Private string token symbol, set once in the ERC20 constructor.
Private uint8 number of decimals, defaulted to 18 in the ERC20 constructor.
constructor(string memory name_, string memory symbol_) of ERC20; stores name/symbol and sets decimals to 18.
constructor() of Token (BEND); calls ERC20("BEND","BEND") and mints 100000 * 10**decimals() to msg.sender.
name() public view returns the stored _name.
symbol() public view returns the stored _symbol.
decimals() public view returns the stored _decimals.
totalSupply() public view returns _totalSupply.
balanceOf(address account) public view returns _balances[account].
transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) moves tokens from _msgSender() via _transfer.
allowance(address owner, address spender) public view returns _allowances[owner][spender].
approve(address spender, uint256 amount) sets the caller's allowance via _approve.
transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) transfers and decrements the caller's allowance.
increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) atomically adds to the caller's allowance.
decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) atomically subtracts from the caller's allowance.
internal _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount); validates addresses, calls the hook and updates balances.
internal _mint(address account, uint256 amount); validates the account, calls the hook and increases supply and balance.
internal _burn(address account, uint256 amount); validates the account, calls the hook and decreases balance and supply.
internal _approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount); validates addresses and writes _allowances.
internal _setupDecimals(uint8 decimals_) allows a derived contract to change decimals.
internal virtual hook _beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount); empty by default, overridable by derived contracts.
Context._msgSender() internal view virtual returns msg.sender.
Context._msgData() internal view virtual returns msg.data.
SafeMath.tryAdd(uint256,uint256) returns (bool,uint256) on overflow detection.
SafeMath.trySub(uint256,uint256) returns (bool,uint256) on underflow detection.
SafeMath.tryMul(uint256,uint256) returns (bool,uint256) on overflow detection.
SafeMath.tryDiv(uint256,uint256) returns (bool,uint256) with a division-by-zero flag.
SafeMath.tryMod(uint256,uint256) returns (bool,uint256) with a modulo-by-zero flag.
SafeMath.add(uint256,uint256) with overflow require.
SafeMath.sub(uint256,uint256) with underflow require.
SafeMath.mul(uint256,uint256) with overflow require.
SafeMath.div(uint256,uint256) with division-by-zero require.
SafeMath.mod(uint256,uint256) with modulo-by-zero require.
SafeMath.sub(uint256,uint256,string) custom-message underflow variant used by ERC20.
SafeMath.div(uint256,uint256,string) custom-message division-by-zero variant.
SafeMath.mod(uint256,uint256,string) custom-message modulo-by-zero variant.
msg.sender, the caller-controlled origin of every state-changing call; also returned by Context._msgSender().
Arithmetic 100000 * (10 ** uint256(decimals())) computing the initial supply in the Token constructor.
Arithmetic _totalSupply = _totalSupply.add(amount) inside _mint.
Arithmetic _balances[account] = _balances[account].add(amount) inside _mint.
Arithmetic _balances[sender].sub(amount, "ERC20: transfer amount exceeds balance") inside _transfer.
Arithmetic _balances[recipient].add(amount) inside _transfer.
Arithmetic _balances[account].sub(amount, "ERC20: burn amount exceeds balance") inside _burn.
Arithmetic _totalSupply = _totalSupply.sub(amount) inside _burn.
Arithmetic allowance decrement _allowances[sender][_msgSender()].sub(amount, "ERC20: transfer amount exceeds allowance") inside transferFrom.
Arithmetic allowance increment _allowances[_msgSender()][spender].add(addedValue) inside increaseAllowance.
Arithmetic allowance decrement _allowances[_msgSender()][spender].sub(subtractedValue, "ERC20: decreased allowance below zero") inside decreaseAllowance.

edges.reason: Token constructor invokes the ERC20 base constructor with name and symbol.
msg.sender is the sole beneficiary of the initial mint in the constructor.
Initial supply arithmetic 100000 * (10 ** uint256(decimals())) executed by the constructor.
Token constructor mints the entire initial supply through _mint.
Token constructor calls decimals() to scale the initial supply.
name_ parameter is assigned to _name in the ERC20 constructor.
symbol_ parameter is assigned to _symbol in the ERC20 constructor.
ERC20 constructor writes _name.
ERC20 constructor writes _symbol.
ERC20 constructor sets _decimals to 18.
name() returns the _name state variable.
symbol() returns the _symbol state variable.
decimals() returns the _decimals state variable.
totalSupply() returns _totalSupply.
balanceOf() reads _balances.
account parameter indexes the _balances mapping.
transfer delegates the state change to _transfer.
transfer obtains the debit account through _msgSender().
msg.sender determines which balance is debited by transfer.
recipient parameter of transfer is forwarded to _transfer.
amount parameter of transfer is forwarded to _transfer.
approve delegates to _approve.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
msg.sender becomes the owner of the allowance set by approve.
spender parameter of approve is forwarded to _approve.
amount parameter of approve becomes the new allowance value.
transferFrom delegates the balance movement to _transfer.
transferFrom updates the remaining allowance via _approve.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender.
Allowance subtraction _allowances[sender][_msgSender()].sub(amount, ...) inside transferFrom.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is consumed by transferFrom.
sender parameter of transferFrom is the debited account.
recipient parameter of transferFrom is the credited account.
amount parameter of transferFrom controls both the transfer and the allowance debit.
increaseAllowance delegates the write to _approve.
increaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
Allowance addition _allowances[_msgSender()][spender].add(addedValue) inside increaseAllowance.
msg.sender owns the allowance that increaseAllowance raises.
spender parameter of increaseAllowance receives the raised allowance.
addedValue parameter is added to the current allowance.
decreaseAllowance delegates the write to _approve.
decreaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
Allowance subtraction _allowances[_msgSender()][spender].sub(subtractedValue, ...) inside decreaseAllowance.
msg.sender owns the allowance that decreaseAllowance lowers.
spender parameter of decreaseAllowance whose allowance is reduced.
subtractedValue parameter is subtracted from the allowance.
allowance() reads the _allowances mapping.
_transfer invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before applying balance effects.
Sender balance subtraction _balances[sender].sub(amount, ...) inside _transfer.
Recipient balance addition _balances[recipient].add(amount) inside _transfer.
_transfer reads and writes the _balances mapping.
sender parameter of _transfer identifies the debited balance.
recipient parameter of _transfer identifies the credited balance.
amount parameter of _transfer is the quantity moved.
_mint invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before increasing supply and balance.
Total supply addition _totalSupply.add(amount) inside _mint.
Balance addition _balances[account].add(amount) inside _mint.
_mint increases the _totalSupply state variable.
_mint increases the _balances entry of the beneficiary.
account parameter of _mint is the mint beneficiary.
amount parameter of _mint is the minted quantity.
_burn invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before decreasing balance and supply.
Balance subtraction _balances[account].sub(amount, ...) inside _burn.
Total supply subtraction _totalSupply.sub(amount) inside _burn.
_burn decreases the _balances entry of the account.
_burn decreases the _totalSupply state variable.
account parameter of _burn is the burned account.
amount parameter of _burn is the burned quantity.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
Context._msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender value.

_balances[account].add resolves to the SafeMath.add library routine.

_balances[recipient].add resolves to the SafeMath.add library routine.
_balances[account].sub with message resolves to SafeMath.sub(uint256,uint256,string).
_totalSupply.sub resolves to the SafeMath.sub library routine.
Allowance decrement resolves to SafeMath.sub(uint256,uint256,string).
Allowance increment resolves to the SafeMath.add library routine.
Allowance decrement resolves to SafeMath.sub(uint256,uint256,string).
SafeMath.tryAdd computes the local c = a + b before the overflow check.
SafeMath.tryMul computes the local c = a * b before the overflow check.
SafeMath.add computes the local c = a + b before the require.
SafeMath.mul computes the local c = a * b before the require.

normalization_plan.reason: name_ is a constructor-only parameter fully consumed by the ERC20 constructor assignment to _name.
symbol_ is a constructor-only parameter fully consumed by the ERC20 constructor assignment to _symbol.
recipient of transfer only flows into _transfer via the transfer function.
amount of transfer only flows into _transfer via the transfer function.
sender of transferFrom is used only inside transferFrom as the debited account.
recipient of transferFrom is used only inside transferFrom as the credited account.
amount of transferFrom is used only inside transferFrom for transfer and allowance debit.
spender of approve is used only inside approve for the _approve call.
amount of approve is used only inside approve as the new allowance value.
spender of increaseAllowance is used only inside increaseAllowance.
addedValue of increaseAllowance is used only inside increaseAllowance for the allowance addition.
spender of decreaseAllowance is used only inside decreaseAllowance.
subtractedValue of decreaseAllowance is used only inside decreaseAllowance for the allowance subtraction.
sender of _transfer is a private internal parameter consumed only by _transfer balance updates.
recipient of _transfer is a private internal parameter consumed only by _transfer balance updates.
amount of _transfer is a private internal parameter consumed only by _transfer arithmetic.
account of _mint is an internal parameter consumed only by _mint.
amount of _mint feeds directly into the _balances[account].add(amount) arithmetic operation.
account of _burn is an internal parameter consumed only by _burn.
amount of _burn feeds directly into the _balances[account].sub(amount) arithmetic operation.
account of balanceOf is a read-only parameter consumed only by balanceOf.
Local c exists only inside SafeMath.tryAdd as the unchecked addition result.
Local c exists only inside SafeMath.tryMul as the unchecked multiplication result.
Local c exists only inside SafeMath.add as the checked addition result.
Local c exists only inside SafeMath.mul as the checked multiplication result.
